title: 第287章 狭道分兵查暗哨，石城停骑遇冷颜
slug: 边军从领取罪女开始一统天下
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

谷口外。

众人静候了半炷香。

派出的斥候总旗顺着碎石堆悄然滑下，几步奔至马前，抱拳低禀：

“大人，查清楚了。两边山崖上确有伏兵，但人数不多，各自不足十人。”

“且皆是依着岩石避风处随意散坐着，还有打盹的，刀枪都未出鞘，并无半点设伏的紧绷架势。”

“看来并非特意针对咱们，只是例行的戍守的暗哨。”

岳大鹏略一思忖，下令道：

“两边各点十个轻身功夫好的弟兄摸上去，给我盯住他们。”

“待大队人马安稳过了这道谷口，你们再跟上。都把家伙收好，切记，莫要轻易动手，咱们是来使，不是打架的。”

总旗干脆应道：

“遵命。”

“慢着！”

岳大鹏眼珠子滴溜溜一转，压住总旗的肩甲。

“这二十个弟兄上去后，便不必再跟着前行。”

“你再留十个人在此地看护马匹，多备两日的干粮水囊。”

“你们这三十号人就地在周遭隐蔽，安营蛰伏。”

“等咱们办完了差事出来，再汇合。若是遇上扎手的硬点子，留个退路总是好的。”

总旗点头，转身点齐人手，二十道身影借着乱石杂木的掩护，转瞬隐没在岩石后方。

另有十人牵着空出的马匹，悄然绕向外围。

岳大鹏这才转头冲探路尖哨挥手：

“往前探，把腰牌文书亮在明处。”

半炷香后。

前方探路的游骑折返，大声回报：

“大人！前方谷口处有铁骊人的哨卡拦路，已将大人的勘合文牒递上去了。”

岳大鹏与陈醉领着余下的七十名精骑，策马入谷。

岳大鹏端坐马上，刻意将后背挺得笔直，余光斜斜往两侧高耸的崖壁上瞥去。

隐隐能瞧见几颗人头在岩石后探出张望，却未有欲要呼喝阻拦的举动。

穿过鬼门关，谷口地势稍平，几十名身披皮甲的铁骊游哨在此设了一道路障。

铁骊校尉验看了一番大宁边军的勘合，面露不悦，却未有多言，只公事公办地打了个手势。

几名士卒搬开路障，校尉领着十余骑在前头引路，将陈醉一行人带入了铁骊国境。

顺着蜿蜒的碎石道行出约莫十里。

转过一道山梁，前头赫然矗立着，一座依山而建的石头城池。

岳大鹏在马上，探着脑袋端详了片刻，眉头皱成了一团。

他凑近陈醉，嘟囔道：

“先生，您先前不是夸口说，铁骊人极善筑城么？怎的这国都乌延城，瞧着连咱们刚拾掇出来的苍牙堡都不如？”

“这城墙统共也就两三丈高，看这架势，也就能住下几千人吧。”

走在前面引路的铁骊校尉耳朵尖，听见抱怨，冷硬地甩回一句：

“睁大你的眼睛看清楚。此乃石喉塞，并非我国都乌延城。”

岳大鹏牛眼一瞪，当即赶上前去，厉声道：

Outside the valley mouth.

Everyone waited quietly for half a stick of incense.

The dispatched scout flag quietly slid down the rubble, ran to the horse in a few steps, clasped his fists and whispered:

"Sir, we have found out. There are indeed ambushes on the cliffs on both sides, but they are not many, less than ten on each side."

"They were all sitting casually on the rocks sheltering from the wind, and some were taking naps. Their swords and guns were not unsheathed, and there was no tense posture to set up an ambush."

"It doesn't seem to be specifically targeting us, it's just a routine defensive sentinel."

Yue Dapeng thought for a while and ordered:

"Order ten brothers on each side who are good at lightness and touch them. Keep an eye on them for me."

"You can follow up after the large group of troops has safely passed the valley entrance. Put the guys away and remember not to attack easily. We are here to envoy, not to fight."

The general flag responded simply:

"As commanded."

"Wait!"

Yue Dapeng rolled his eyes and pressed down on the shoulder armor of the general flag.

"After these twenty brothers go up, there is no need to follow them any further."

"Leave ten more people here to look after the horses, and prepare two more days of dry food and water bags."

"You guys, number 30, are hiding in the surroundings, setting up camp and dormant."

"We'll meet up after we finish our errands and come out. If we encounter a tough idea, it's always good to have an escape route."

The general flag nodded, turned around and ordered all the people's hands. Twenty figures took advantage of the cover of the rocks and trees and disappeared behind the rocks in an instant.

Another ten people led the vacated horses and quietly walked around the perimeter.

Yue Dapeng then turned around and waved at the path-exploring sentry:

"Go forward and show the badge documents in a bright place."

After half a stick of incense.

The riders exploring the road ahead turned back and reported loudly:

"Sir! There is a checkpoint of the Tieli people blocking the road at the entrance of the valley ahead. Your Excellency's document of exploration and cooperation has been handed over."

Yue Dapeng and Chen Zui led the remaining seventy elite riders and rode into the valley.

Yue Dapeng sat upright on his horse, deliberately keeping his back straight, and glanced sideways at the towering cliffs on both sides.

A few human heads could be vaguely seen peeking out from behind the rocks, but they made no move to stop them.

After passing through Guimen Pass, the terrain at the mouth of the valley is slightly flat, and dozens of Tieliang sentries wearing leather armor have set up a roadblock here.

Colonel Tie Li inspected the survey of Daning's border troops and showed displeasure, but did not say much and only made a business-like gesture.

A few soldiers moved the roadblock, and the school captain led more than ten riders to lead the way, leading Chen Zui and his party into the Tieli Kingdom.

Follow the winding gravel road for about ten miles.

After turning around a mountain ridge, a stone city built on the mountain stood in front of us.

Yue Dapeng stood on the horse and looked at it for a moment, his brows furrowed.

He approached Chen Zui and muttered:

"Sir, didn't you boast before that the Tieli people are very good at building cities? How come Wuyan City, the capital of the country, is not even as good as the Cangya Castle we just built?"

"This city wall is only two or three feet high. Looking at its size, it can accommodate several thousand people."

Colonel Tie Li, who was leading the way, had sharp ears. When he heard the complaints, he coldly replied:

"Open your eyes and see clearly. This is a stone throat plug, not Wuyan City, the capital of our country."

Yue Dapeng's eyes widened and he immediately rushed forward and said sternly:
